questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what did the guiding man call the room twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide?
In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what did the guiding man call the wooden altar that was three cubits high?

answers.text: The table that is before the LORD
The mercy seat of the LORD

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, why must priests leave their ministering garments behind before going out to the outer court?

answers.text: Because those garments belong to the high priest

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision, a wall surrounded the temple area, five hundred cubits on each side. What was the wall for?

answers.text: To separate the holy from the common
To keep enemy armies from getting in
To mark where the city's edge begins
